formal_statement: ∀ (σ : Type) [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (Z : Submodule (ZMod 2) (MvPolynomial σ (ZMod 2))) (K k : ℕ), (∀ p ∈ Z, p.totalDegree < K → ∀ i : σ, MvPolynomial.X i * p ∈ Z) → (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (i : σ), d.degree + 2 ≤ K → MvPolynomial.monomial d (1 : ZMod 2) * (MvPolynomial.X i ^ 2 - MvPolynomial.X i) ∈ Z) → k + 1 ≤ K → Module.finrank (ZMod 2) ((MvPolynomial.restrictTotalDegree σ (ZMod 2) (k + 1)).map Z.mkQ) * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (Fintype.card σ).choose j) ≤ Module.finrank (ZMod 2) ((MvPolynomial.restrictTotalDegree σ (ZMod 2) k).map Z.mkQ) * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), (Fintype.card σ).choose j)
plain_statement: For a subspace Z of F2 polynomials closed under multiplication by a variable below degree K and containing the monomial multiples of x^2 - x up to degree K: c(k+1) N(k) is at most c(k) N(k+1) for k + 1 at most K, where c(k) is the dimension of degree-k polynomials modulo Z and N(k) counts multilinear monomials of degree at most k. Lemma 4.1 of the unrefereed arXiv:2610.00837; a link of L-pcx-042.
title: Monotone normalised rank: modulo a variable-closed subspace containing the Boolean multiples, dim(V_k / Z) / N(k) does not increase with k
